title: Centuries-old physics test could help detect millicharged particles
title_zh: 百年物理测试探测微电荷粒子
summary: 文章聚焦微电荷粒子（mCPs）这一标准模型外假想粒子，其核心特征是携带远小于电子的电荷，因此与普通物质和电磁场耦合极弱。摘要只说明一种百年物理测试可被改造为探测方案，但未给出具体装置、参数或灵敏度上限。对凝聚态与 AI for science 的直接关联很弱，更多是精密弱信号探测的概念性借鉴。
abstract: Theoretical physicists have long predicted the existence of millicharged particles (mCPs), hypothetical particles that carry a very small electric charge. These particles are expected to interact very weakly with ordinary matter and electromagnetic fields; hence, they would be difficult to detect in conventional particle physics experiments.
